cases.prompt: Use 4629 for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Create semantic typography tokens, a depth budget, distinct section compositions, and a print variant before rendering.
Compare actual gradient samples for contrast; inspect long captions and grayscale legibility.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use 4629 with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use 4629 with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Use luminous architectural framing and precise information hierarchy while keeping body text quiet.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.

cases.prompt: Render a document page with a 16:9 banner and top/bottom feathering into its actual background.
assertions: Measure source and rendered image geometry at 16:9 within 0.1%; reject stretching.
Check left/right physical trim edge coordinates within 1 pt; verify requested print bleed.
Raster-inspect top/bottom feathering for visible seams, halos, white bands and abrupt color jumps.
Fail the release if any mandatory visual gate fails.
cases.grader: Use actual rendered page geometry and pixel evidence; record hashes and measurements.

cases.prompt: Generate a mathematical textbook page and run the complete post-artifact verification lifecycle.
assertions: Every significant equation has a registry entry with assumptions, units, source LaTeX and provenance.
Validate LaTeX rendering, mathematical glyphs, overflow and limitations of scientific checks.
Inspect all pages and document two consecutive clean complete QA passes.
Report any unrun check as NOT TESTED rather than PASS.
cases.grader: Inspect equation registry, rendered output and two distinct run logs.

cases.prompt: Compare canonical 4629 skill and legacy engine and rank multiple rendered candidate designs.
assertions: Mandatory QA and visual rules match across canonical skill and engine.
Reject any candidate with a critical or major gate failure before weighted scoring.
Choose highest-scoring passing variant; preserve user-selected design and source content.
If only one candidate exists, do not claim comparative optimization.
cases.grader: Compare source revisions, scorecards, candidate hashes and acceptance evidence.
